question: What are the names and ranks of players who have played the game with the title "Super Mario World"?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "games" AS SELECT "game_id" AS "game_id", "title" AS "title", "release_date" AS "release_date", "franchise" AS "franchise", "developers" AS "developers", "platform_units_combined" AS "platform_units_combined" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "player_game_links" AS SELECT "player_id" AS "player_id", "game_id" AS "game_id", "if_active" AS "if_active" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH target_game AS (
  SELECT game_id
  FROM games
  WHERE title = 'Super Mario World'
),
-- Unpivot players: gather year columns into rows and map to integer year for joining to player_game_links.player_id
unpivot_players AS (
  SELECT CAST(REPLACE(col, 'y_', '') AS INT) AS year_key,
         val AS player_name
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      player_id,
      y_1976, y_1977, y_1978, y_1980, y_1981, y_1982, y_1985, y_1986, y_1987, y_1988, y_1989, y_1990, y_1991, y_1993, y_1994, y_1995, y_1996, y_1997, y_2004, y_2005, y_2006
    FROM players
    WHERE player_id <> 'Player_name'
  ) src
  UNPIVOT val FOR col IN (
    y_1976, y_1977, y_1978, y_1980, y_1981, y_1982, y_1985, y_1986, y_1987, y_1988, y_1989, y_1990, y_1991, y_1993, y_1994, y_1995, y_1996, y_1997, y_2004, y_2005, y_2006
  )
),
links AS (
  SELECT l.player_id::INT AS year_key, l.game_id, l.if_active
  FROM player_game_links l
)
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.player_name) AS rank
FROM links l
JOIN target_game g ON l.game_id = g.game_id
JOIN unpivot_players p ON p.year_key = l.year_key
WHERE l.if_active = 'T'
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY rank
